title: Nuevo Laredo offers free training for entrepreneurs this Friday
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo's municipal government is inviting residents to a free training session for entrepreneurs on Friday, Nov. 13, from 4:00 to 5:30 p.m. at the Bienestar Social meeting room.
content:
The municipal government of Nuevo Laredo is inviting residents to a free training session for entrepreneurs this Friday, Nov. 13, from 4:00 to 5:30 p.m. in the meeting room of the Secretaría de Bienestar Social, according to Desde Donde Estamos.

The Capacitación para Emprendedores session is aimed at people who want to build their business skills and take their ventures to the next level. Participants will be able to pick up tools and strategies to improve their sales, grow their businesses and strengthen their entrepreneurial projects, the report said.

The session is organized by the administration of Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal through the Secretaría de Bienestar Social. The city said the effort is meant to bring learning and training opportunities closer to residents who want to grow their businesses and strengthen their entrepreneurial initiatives.

Those interested can register online through the link provided by the city: https://bit.ly/CAPACITACIÓNEMPRENDEDORES.

Sources: Desde Donde Estamos, Armando Castillo Gutiérrez, “Invitan en Nuevo Laredo a capacitación para emprendedores” (Nov. 12, 2026).
